rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, reviewed the user’s orders via tools, and accurately reported that the only delivered order was a camera while the laptop order was still pending. The agent did not perform any writes and thus did not need confirmation; it also avoided fabricating details. Given the discrepancy between the user’s claim (laptop received) and the system status (pending), the agent appropriately offered and completed a handoff to a human agent, which aligns with policy when the request cannot be completed with available tools. A minor shortcoming is that the agent did not proactively offer to cancel the pending laptop order as a fallback per the user’s initial request; however, the user then asked for human assistance, and the agent complied. Overall, actions were policy-compliant and accurate.
